detailed_description:
The target video uses polished cinematic 3D character animation in a vertical 9:16 music-video format. It combines the warm nighttime visual identity of <Picture 1> with the spontaneous, front-facing riding performance of <Video 1>. The result should feel like the bear is genuinely riding through the night and singing along naturally, rather than standing still and mechanically opening its mouth.

[Shot 1] A continuous 43.93-second single take begins with <Subject 1> riding the same pale electric scooter through <Subject 2>. The framing follows <Subject 3>: a close front-facing composition mounted slightly below the bear’s eye line, showing the helmeted head, expressive face, upper torso, both paws on the handlebars, and the illuminated circular headlight near the bottom of the frame.

The scooter travels steadily forward at a safe, moderate speed. The camera moves with the scooter and maintains the same close distance, with only gentle physically motivated vibration from the road. Trees and streetlights drift backward naturally in the background. Warm amber light repeatedly sweeps across the bear’s fur and helmet, alternating with cooler areas of nighttime shadow.

<Subject 1> (S1) physically performs every vocal phrase in exact synchronization with the fully reused <Audio 1>. Its mouth shapes remain adapted to the bear’s muzzle anatomy: clear and expressive but never humanized excessively. The jaw, muzzle, cheeks, eyebrows, and eyes move together naturally with the melody. Both paws remain safely and consistently attached to the handlebars throughout the entire ride.

From 00:00.000 to approximately 00:05.440, the instrumental introduction and repeated non-lexical vocalizations from <Audio 1> begin. <Subject 1> (S1) joins the melody with rhythmic open-mouth vocal shapes, gently bobbing its helmeted head. One eyebrow lifts while the larger eye widens with playful enthusiasm. The bear briefly glances toward the road and then back toward the front-mounted camera without moving its paws.

From approximately 00:05.440 to 00:09.000, <Subject 1> (S1) sings with a sincere, slightly bashful expression: <d>[Mandarin singing] 我～偷偷地爱上你。</d> The muzzle opens gradually on the sustained opening syllable. Its eyes soften, and its head tilts slightly to one side as a warm streetlight moves across the helmet and right cheek.

From approximately 00:09.000 to 00:12.480, it continues: <d>[Mandarin singing] 却不敢告诉你。</d> The bear briefly lowers its eyes, then looks forward again. Its thick eyebrows draw inward with restrained emotion while the scooter continues moving steadily.

From approximately 00:12.480 to 00:14.680, it sings: <d>[Mandarin singing] 因为我知道。</d> The camera remains close and continuous. A brighter streetlight passes overhead, gradually revealing the fur texture, muzzle, eyes, and glossy helmet before the face returns to softer shadow.

From approximately 00:14.680 to 00:17.640, it sings: <d>[Mandarin singing] 我给不到你要的东西。</d> The bear opens its mouth more fully on the longer notes, then gently compresses its lips at the end of the phrase. Its eyes briefly close with genuine feeling while its paws and scooter remain physically stable.

From approximately 00:17.640 to 00:19.840, <Subject 1> (S1) performs the melodic vocalization: <d>[Mandarin vocalization] 喔哦我我～</d> It lifts its chin slightly toward the night sky, allowing the helmet and muzzle to catch a moving golden rim light.

From approximately 00:19.840 to 00:23.480, it sings: <d>[Mandarin singing] 只能偷偷地想你。</d> The bear looks forward with a tender expression, then makes a small rhythmic side-to-side head movement matching the performance energy of <Subject 3>. The background foliage and streetlights continue flowing backward.

From approximately 00:23.480 to 00:26.880, it continues: <d>[Mandarin singing] 只能偷偷看着你。</d> A spontaneous smile briefly appears between syllables. Its eyes glance toward the camera, then return safely to the road.

From approximately 00:26.880 to 00:29.080, it sings: <d>[Mandarin singing] 总是没勇气。</d> The expression becomes more vulnerable. The eyebrows lift at the inner corners, and the mouth movement remains precisely synchronized without stretching or distorting the muzzle.

From approximately 00:29.080 to 00:30.640, it sings: <d>[Mandarin singing] 总说不出。</d> The bear takes a visible but subtle breath, momentarily reducing its head movement as the scooter crosses a darker section of the road.

From approximately 00:30.640 to 00:36.640, <Subject 1> (S1) sings the emotional final lyric: <d>[Mandarin singing] 我是真的爱上你。</d> Its performance grows more open and heartfelt. It closes its eyes briefly during the sustained note, raises its chin, and then opens its eyes as a strong amber streetlight illuminates the entire face. The eyes, eyebrows, cheeks, muzzle, and jaw express the emotion together while the bear remains safely balanced.

From approximately 00:36.640 to 00:43.930, the vocal line ends and the instrumental outro from <Audio 1> continues. The bear closes its mouth, breathes naturally, and relaxes into a small satisfied smile. It looks ahead while continuing to ride. A final streetlight passes behind the helmet, creating a bright golden flare and a soft rim of light around the bear’s ears and fur.

The camera remains close and front-facing through the final frame, retaining the spontaneous riding-video character of <Video 1>. The scooter headlight, passing road, moving foliage, fur, and reflected helmet light remain active. There is no sudden camera pullback, cut, freeze frame, or abrupt stop.
